class.name: WorldPartition3D
class.brief_description: Streams 3D scene instances in a grid around a viewer.
class.description: [WorldPartition3D] divides its local X/Z plane into square cells and instantiates nearby [PackedScene]s at runtime. Each cell is identified by a [Vector2i] coordinate and can reference either a [PackedScene] resource or a [String] scene path (such as [code]res://world/0_0.tscn[/code]). Scene roots must inherit [Node3D], and their authored local position is preserved relative to the cell origin. Assign [member cells], [member cell_size], [member load_radius], and [member viewer_path]. The viewer position is evaluated every frame, but scene instances change only on crossing cell boundaries. Alternatively, call [method update_streaming] manually. Negative world coordinates and transformed partition nodes are supported. Only children instantiated by this node are unloaded; children manually added in the editor remain untouched. This is an initial synchronous instance-streaming implementation. Loading scene paths may block the main thread. It does not yet include an editor cell painter, asynchronous resource streaming, HLOD generation, or world-origin rebasing. If using scene paths rather than explicit [PackedScene] references, ensure that those scene files are included in exports.

method.name: get_cell_source
method.description: Returns the scene path or [PackedScene] assigned to [param coords], or [code]null[/code] if none exists.

method.name: get_loaded_cell
method.description: Returns the live instance root for [param coords], or [code]null[/code] if this cell is not loaded.

method.name: get_loaded_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of instantiated cells.

method.name: remove_cell
method.description: Removes the cell entry and invalidates the current streaming state.

method.name: set_cell_path
method.description: Registers a scene path for a cell. The resource is loaded when that cell is needed. This is suitable for very large registries.

method.name: set_cell_scene
method.description: Registers a [PackedScene] resource for a cell. The resource is retained, while its node hierarchy is only instantiated when needed.

method.name: unload_all_cells
method.description: Removes all streamed cell instances without clearing their registrations. The next update can reload them.

method.name: update_streaming
method.description: Updates loaded cells around [param world_position], using global coordinates. The node must be in the active [SceneTree].

method.name: world_to_cell
method.description: Returns the cell containing [param world_position]. Calculations use the partition node's local coordinates.

members.member: Horizontal dimensions of one cell, in the local space of the partition. Must be positive and finite.
Maps [Vector2i] coordinates to scene paths ([String]) or [PackedScene] resources. This dictionary is copied on assignment and retrieval.
Chebyshev radius in cells around the viewer, from 0 to 16. For example, 1 loads up to 3 by 3 cells.
Path to a [Node3D] used for automatic streaming. If empty, use [method update_streaming] manually.

signal.name: cell_load_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a registered cell scene could not be loaded or instantiated.

signal.name: cell_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after a new cell is instantiated.

signal.name: cell_unloaded
signal.description: Emitted before a cell instance is destroyed.
